# EHole fingerprint data

`finger.json` and `LICENSE` are vendored from the official
[EdgeSecurityTeam/EHole](https://github.com/EdgeSecurityTeam/EHole) repository.
The data is loaded as a rule source by AION's passive fingerprint engine; AION
does not invoke the EHole CLI or issue EHole-specific requests.
